contexts.text: The levirate represented the preservation and continuation of the Church.

Perform the levirate to her () = that he should continue the representative of the Church... To perform the levirate = to preserve and continue that which is of the Church. The levirate defined. It was not new in the Jewish Church...
The law of the levirate quoted ().
The signification of the law of the levirate explained. AC 4835:4.
Not to perform the levirate = not to want the good and truth of the Church, and its continuation.
